mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,created_by,status,storage_key,run_token,file_size, (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS expired FROM inventory_export_tasks WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND created_by=#{userId} AND id=#{taskId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM inventory_export_task_sites WHERE task_id = #{task.id} AND tenant_id = #{task.tenantId}

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM inventory_export_tasks WHERE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory_export_task_sites snapshot WHERE snapshot.task_id = #{task.id} AND snapshot.tenant_id = #{task.tenantId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory_export_task_sites snapshot LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.id = snapshot.site_id AND s.tenant_id = snapshot.tenant_id WHERE snapshot.task_id = #{task.id} AND snapshot.tenant_id = #{task.tenantId} AND (s.id IS NULL OR NOT (s.tenant_id = #{task.tenantId} AND s.enabled = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u JOIN tenant_memberships m ON m.user_id = u.id JOIN tenants te ON te.id = m.tenant_id WHERE u.id = #{task.createdBy} AND te.id = #{task.tenantId} AND u.enabled=1 AND m.enabled=1 AND te.enabled=1 AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_member_roles mr JOIN roles r ON r.id = mr.role_id WHERE mr.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND mr.membership_id = m.id AND r.role_code = 'TENANT_ADMIN') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tenant_member_site_scopes sc WHERE sc.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND sc.membership_id = m.id AND sc.site_id = s.id))))))
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_export_tasks SET error_code='FILE_MISSING', error_message='导出文件不存在或不可用，请重新导出',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE
